# ruff: noqa: F821
# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def proximity_of(mean_latency_ms: float) -> float:
    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 45.0
    return 1.0 - min(scaled, 0.9)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    # Headroom on the bottleneck resource: the queueing term. Contention, not capacity
    # admission, is what breaks the SLO here, so the *margin* is what matters.
    headroom = 1.0 - peak

    # Rate-weighted mean latency to this pod's already-placed call-graph neighbours.
    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                weighted = weighted + rate * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weight = weight + rate

    # A pod with no placed neighbours yet gets a neutral 0.5 rather than a free 1.0:
    # rewarding "no neighbours" would bias the very first replica of every service.
    proximity = 0.5
    if weight > 0.0:
        proximity = proximity_of(weighted / weight)

    # Idle draw spans 1.8 W (far edge) to 108 W (the dev-1 fog server); the divisor keeps
    # the term bounded without hard-coding a tier test.
    efficiency = 1.0 - min(node.power_idle_w / 120.0, 1.0)
    return headroom * 0.50 + proximity * 0.2625 + efficiency * 0.075

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    edges = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source_pod = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
        destination_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[(source_pod.cpu_request)]]
        movable = (
            moved < budget
            and source_pod.current_node >= 0
            and destination_pod.current_node >= 0
            and source_pod.current_node != destination_pod.current_node
            and not source_pod.stateful
            and not source_pod.has_pdb
        )
        if movable:
            target = state.nodes[destination_pod.current_node]
            cpu_cap = float(max(target.cpu_capacity, 1))
            mem_cap = float(max(target.mem_capacity, 1))
            cpu_after = float(target.cpu_allocated + source_pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
            mem_after = float(target.mem_allocated + source_pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
            # Only co-locate when the target keeps real margin afterwards: an
            # unconditional pull is what makes latency_greedy overload.
            if not target.suspended and max(cpu_after, mem_after) < 0.70:
                out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, destination_pod.current_node))
                moved = moved + 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def proximity_of(mean_latency_ms: float) -> float:
    scaled = mean_latency_ms / 45.0
    return 1.0 - min(scaled, 1.0)

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 1.0:
        return -1000000.0

    headroom = 1.0 - peak

    pressure_penalty = 0.0
    if peak > 0.40:
        pressure_penalty = (peak - 0.40) * 3.5
    if peak > 0.60:
        pressure_penalty = pressure_penalty + (peak - 0.60) * 5.5
    if peak > 0.78:
        pressure_penalty = pressure_penalty + (peak - 0.78) * 9.0

    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    max_latency = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                latency = node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weighted = weighted + rate * latency
                weight = weight + rate
                if latency > max_latency:
                    max_latency = latency

    proximity = 0.5
    if weight > 0.0:
        mean_lat = weighted / weight
        mean_prox = 1.0 - min(mean_lat / 20.0, 1.0)
        worst_prox = 1.0 - min(max_latency / 12.0, 1.0)
        proximity = mean_prox * 0.20 + worst_prox * 0.80

    efficiency = 1.0 - min(node.power_idle_w / 120.0, 1.0)
    return headroom * 0.25 + proximity * 0.70 + efficiency * 0.05 - pressure_penalty

def node_peak_after(state: ClusterState, node_idx: int, pod: Pod) -> float:
    node = state.nodes[node_idx]
    if node.suspended:
        return 1.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    return max(cpu_after, mem_after)

def node_peak_now(state: ClusterState, node_idx: int) -> float:
    node = state.nodes[node_idx]
    if node.suspended:
        return 1.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_now = float(node.cpu_allocated) / cpu_cap
    mem_now = float(node.mem_allocated) / mem_cap
    return max(cpu_now, mem_now)

def already_moved(moved_pods: list[int], pid: int) -> bool:
    for p in moved_pods:
        if p == pid:
            return True
    return False

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    moved_pods: list[int] = []
    edges = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        source_pod = state.pods[graph.src[e]]
        destination_pod = state.pods[graph.dst[e]]
        eligible = (
            source_pod.current_node >= 0
            and destination_pod.current_node >= 0
            and source_pod.current_node != destination_pod.current_node
        )
        if eligible:
            source_node_idx = source_pod.current_node
            dest_node_idx = destination_pod.current_node
            source_node = state.nodes[source_node_idx]
            current_latency = source_node.latency_to_ms[dest_node_idx]
            source_peak = node_peak_now(state, source_node_idx)
            dest_peak = node_peak_now(state, dest_node_idx)

            source_movable = (
                not source_pod.stateful
                and not source_pod.has_pdb
                and not already_moved(moved_pods, source_pod.id)
            )
            dest_movable = (
                not destination_pod.stateful
                and not destination_pod.has_pdb
                and not already_moved(moved_pods, destination_pod.id)
            )

            source_target_peak = 1.0
            if source_movable:
                source_target_peak = node_peak_after(state, dest_node_idx, source_pod)

            dest_target_peak = 1.0
            if dest_movable:
                dest_target_peak = node_peak_after(state, source_node_idx, destination_pod)

            source_worthy = current_latency > 16.0 or source_peak > 0.68
            dest_worthy = current_latency > 16.0 or dest_peak > 0.68
            source_helps = source_target_peak < 0.58 and source_target_peak < source_peak
            dest_helps = dest_target_peak < 0.58 and dest_target_peak < dest_peak

            if source_movable and source_helps and source_worthy:
                out.append(move_pod(source_pod.id, dest_node_idx))
                moved = moved + 1
                moved_pods.append(source_pod.id)
            elif dest_movable and dest_helps and dest_worthy:
                out.append(move_pod(destination_pod.id, source_node_idx))
                moved = moved + 1
                moved_pods.append(destination_pod.id)
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END

    # rewarding "no neighbours" would bias the very first replica of every service.
    proximity = 0.5
